Name: Enhanced Rings
Author: stf7799
Description:
[size=4]Inspired by certain vanilla game mechanics, I created this mod, which includes:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Burglar Ring Plus and its ascended versions. You'll need various metal bars and loot from the mines to upgrade the vanilla Burglar Ring (and its improved versions). The recipes are unlocked at Combat Skill levels 3, 5, and 7.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]A new ring series that increases monster spawn rates in mines and dungeons. Craft the basic version with iron bars, slime, and bat wings, then upgrade it using rare monster drops and precious metals. Recipes unlock at Combat levels 2, 4, and 6.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Added 4 new combined rings based on the original gem rings, each providing specialized stat enhancements.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Introduced Iridium Band Alpha - a unique with completely different bonuses compared to vanilla iridium bands.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Napalm Ring Plus - Bigger explode![/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Chef's Ring! Enhances your cooking, making your culinary efforts more rewarding![/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Legendary Fish Ring,a ring that allows you to catch Legendary Fish II anytime.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Extra Fish Ring. More fish! Of course, you have to collect a lot of things for this .[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Quality Ring.Enable you to consistently harvest crops of a certain level or above, or catch fish of at least some quality[/size]
[/*]
[/list][size=4]Configurable ring abilities can be modified via the configuration file. If you have GenericModConfigMenu installed (please ensure you have the latest version), an in-game GUI interface is also provided for easier adjustment.[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Tired of cluttered crafting menus? Don't want to use certain rings? You can now disable any recipe in the configuration.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Note: After saving configuration changes, a game restart is required as recipes are cached at startup.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]
QA:
Q: Can I combine these rings?
A: Of course! These rings are registered using the original Ring class and can be combined, separated, and saved normally. But don't expect any images.
Q: Can they be added or uninstalled midway?
A: Yes! Currently, rings can only be obtained through crafting, which depends on your skill to unlock recipes, so they can be added midway. The rings themselves are just ordinary items, and their functionality relies on code. So if you uninstall them, they will become faulty items and can simply be discarded.
Q: Will they affect the original game's functions?
A: Not at all. When writing the program, my top priority was maintaining the original game's logic. Even if you hot-reload and remove this mod during gameplay, the game will still continue to run.
Q: These rings are too powerful! I'm worried they might shorten my game's longevity.
A: I've provided ample configuration options, and many features are customizable. You can also disable the recipes to prevent obtaining them.

Incompatibility:  
Better Crafting: Replaces the cooking menu, so my cooking-related features will not function.  
Android Platform: Issues unknown, still under testing.[/size]

[size=4]Known issue:
If you take on the 'Big Family' quest, please turn off the Legendary Fish Ring feature in order to obtain the legendary fish as normal. The game's built‑in parser cannot handle two incoming events at the same time. I'm working on it.

[i][size=2]Note: The mod utilizes Harmony to patch the original game code. I employ a relatively safe postfix approach to avoid modifying the original game code, while also adding a toggle for the patch. Nevertheless, if any issues arise, please check whether they are caused by this mod first. Additionally, Harmony patches do not guarantee cross-platform compatibility (currently tested only on Windows). If you wish to test it on other platforms, please ensure you are adequately prepared.[/size][/i][/size]
